issue.title: sase-core tool_run store contention tests hit SQLite busy timeouts under the loaded check lane

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by footprint phase sase-1p1.12--4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #5) on 2026-10-28. While it verified the sase-core footprint export/import commit, `sase tool run check` in sase-core (ToolRun witness e806578cc8f9fec509172149f2c41b66) failed two Rust tests under the full parallel check with SQLite busy/WAL lock timeouts:

- tool_run::store::tests::contention::barrier_orders_exclusive_holder_then_show
- tool_run::store::tests::contention::retry_after_releasable_lock_does_not_duplicate_run

Both passed when rerun in isolation on the unchanged tree, and the phase's footprint code does not touch tool_run. Fail rate: 1 of 1 loaded full checks, 0 isolated failures. The lock holder was not identified. The symptom matches the sase-side ToolRun store-busy family (sase-18t), but these are separate Rust nodes in sase-core with their own timeouts, so the root cause may differ.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (in sase-core, loaded host)

issue.creation_reason: A footprint phase saw two sase-core ToolRun contention tests fail under a loaded check and pass in isolation; no existing task tracks these Rust nodes.

payload.description: Same symptom family (ToolRun SQLite store busy under load) on the sase side; check for a shared lock-holder root cause
